title: Daresay Corny Kelleher bagged the job for O’Neill’s. Singing with his eyes shut. Corny
html_source:
Corny Kelleher will come to Bloom’s mind many times along the day. He thinks Kelleher is a police informant. Whenever we come across Corny’s (from Cornelius) name, Bloom always thinks of the song he sings “I vowed that I never would leave her”.
(Frank Delaney’s podcast re:Joyce 193, Funeral Music).
